artifacts.role: Host preview, approval, and submission adapter.
Host approval, redaction, and failure regression tests.
Host-owned copy of the declared relay source subtree.

invariants.invariant: There is one feedback shape; errors and capability gaps are optional context, not categories.
invariants.evidence: One host adapter builds feedback.Input with optional recent error and capability gaps.

invariants.invariant: No report is submitted in the background or before an explicit user action.
invariants.evidence: Cancellation and preview tests observe zero HTTP requests before the second action.

invariants.invariant: Every outbound free-text field is redacted and bounded before approval.
invariants.evidence: Host tests cover default and product-specific redaction before Draft.Approve.

invariants.invariant: Draft.Report is a deep-copied preview and cannot be JSON-marshaled; only opaque Approved emits Feedback v1 JSON.
invariants.evidence: Preview equivalence and serialization refusal are asserted by focused tests.

invariants.invariant: The core payload contains structured report data and no issue title, Markdown body, card, or localized presentation.
invariants.evidence: Presentation exists only in the host adapter; the foundation payload remains structured.

invariants.invariant: Automatically captured environment data is a fixed allowlist.
invariants.evidence: The host maps only product, version, OS, architecture, and agent.

invariants.invariant: The provided HTTP client never follows redirects for an approved feedback POST.
invariants.evidence: The host uses feedback/httpclient.Client without a second transport.

invariants.invariant: The provided HTTP client and reference relay use only POST /v1/feedback for wire schema 1.
invariants.evidence: Endpoint configuration and transport tests use the exact v1 path.

invariants.invariant: The client has no GitHub token and cannot select the relay target repository.
invariants.evidence: Client configuration contains only the relay endpoint; repository and token remain server-side.

invariants.invariant: The relay validates schema, approval, fields, and byte limits again.
invariants.evidence: The pinned relay subtree and source CI include strict schema and workerd tests.
